name: handoff
description: Save task state to disk and resume it in a fresh Codex task by id. Automatic /ahandoff is Claude Code only; here use $handoff and $handoff resume <id> by hand.

interface.shortDescription: Save and resume durable task context
interface.longDescription: Writes durable Markdown handoffs and restores them by short id in another task. The automatic /ahandoff loop is Claude Code only.
defaultPrompt: Save a handoff for this task.
